SELECT i.id, i.title, i.status, i.version, i.closed_at FROM "incident" i INNER JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.incident_id = i.id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ia.account_id = #{accountId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND i.status = 'OPEN'
AND UPPER(#{status}) = 'OPEN'
ORDER BY i.opened_at DESC, i.id ASC

SELECT i.id, i.status, i.version FROM "incident" i INNER JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.incident_id = i.id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE i.id = #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.account_id = #{accountId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND i.status = 'OPEN' LIMIT 1

SELECT i.id, i.status, i.version, i.closed_at FROM "incident" i INNER JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.incident_id = i.id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE i.id = #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.account_id = #{accountId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND i.status = 'CLOSED' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_assignment WHERE account_id = #{accountId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL

SELECT incident_id, display_name, photo_object_key, appearance_text, last_seen_location_text, last_seen_at FROM missing_person WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

SELECT account_id, incident_role FROM incident_assignment WHERE incident_id = #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY assigned_at ASC, account_id ASC

SELECT ia.account_id, ia.incident_role, a.account_type, a.organization_type, CAST(pp.id AS VARCHAR) AS police_phone_id FROM incident_assignment ia LEFT JOIN account a ON CAST(a.id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(ia.account_id AS VARCHAR) LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON CAST(pp.account_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(ia.account_id AS VARCHAR) AND pp.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE ia.incident_id = #{incidentId, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY ia.assigned_at ASC, ia.account_id ASC, pp.id ASC
